steps.content: A girl as deep as the night, she has long hair and wears a misty dance costume. Under the red light, the hem of her dress and her long hair are dancing and bouncing animatedly.
Beautiful and frightening.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: What on earth happened here?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: The enchanting muse, <color=#fb9259>Hamel</color>.
She releases the safety of the silver gun in her hand and aims at Hamel.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Based on the salvaged surveillance footage, at 12:39 on June 27, N.F. 89, Hamel entered the Carnival. At 13:10, it was detected that an S-class Sinner went manic in the Carnival. Simultaneously, the first Black Ring broke out.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Using your experience as an example, she's the Zoya of this place, <color=#fb9259>ground zero of BR-001</color>, the owner of the Carnival's Black Ring.

The girl raises her arms to her chest, then spreads them to the two sides gracefully. As if summoned by her movement, the Corruptors begin running toward the center of the Black Ring even more frantically.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Are you all here to watch me dance?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You all love me, don't you?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I'm so glad... I love you all dearly too.
Amid the woman's sweet, blissful laughter, the Corruptors crowd around her like pilgrims. But once they get close to her, they immediately let out agonized cries.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Aaahhh...!!
They twist and contort instantly, transform into black shadows, and get devoured by the woman!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: This way, we can be together forever...

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: The Black Ring in the square only existed for a week, this one here is the first <color=#fb9259>secondary Black Ring</color> born 23 years ago. Of course people are in a different state here.
Behind Hecate, the Nightmare seems to be affected as well and is looking very disturbed.
Hamel seems to have noticed you all and gives you a sweet and innocent smile.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Are you here to watch the performance too?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: She's the most powerful Catalyst Sinner known to date and possesses a power called <color=#fb9259>Blissful Illusion</color>. The Corruptors in the Rust have all fallen into madness for her.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: But in the past two weeks, this has been happening a bit too often. She can seldom walk out like this.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: If the BR-004 operation report is legit, in order to destroy the Black Ring, we must eliminate Hamel.

Langley raises her gun and shoots without any hesitation. The bullet flies toward Hamel. Right before it hits the target, a mad Corruptor jumps out and takes the bullet for Hamel, vanishing immediately.
But the girl doesn't even glance at it. She only stares at you all curiously, tilting her head.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Do you not like Hamel? Why don't you like Hamel?
Perhaps sensing your hostility, like puppets whose strings are pulled, the surrounding Corruptors all turn and start charging at you suddenly!
